ALTER TABLE task
    ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS assessment_purpose VARCHAR(32);

UPDATE task
SET assessment_purpose = 'knowledge_check'
WHERE assessment_purpose IS NULL;

ALTER TABLE task
    ALTER COLUMN assessment_purpose SET DEFAULT 'knowledge_check',
    ALTER COLUMN assessment_purpose SET NOT NULL;

ALTER TABLE task
    ADD CONSTRAINT task_assessment_purpose_check
    CHECK (assessment_purpose IN ('knowledge_check', 'diagnostic'));

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_task_diagnostic_purpose
    ON task (assessment_purpose, lesson_id, "order", id)
    WHERE assessment_purpose = 'diagnostic';
